programme.title: Supertato S02 - Freezy Sprinklers - EP 29
programme.desc: Evil Pea plots to take over the whole supermarket by making fake freezy sprinklers to fool Supertato. But what is her real plan, and will Supertato stop her?

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Tatocar vs Evil Peamobile Song - EP 10
programme.desc: The Tatoteam have the Tatocar and Evil Pea has the Evil Peamobile. But which one of these machines is best? Carrot and Evil Pea have a song to decide.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - The Monstertato Song - EP 1
programme.desc: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Being Quiet Badge - EP 6
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn't like noise time to earn their Being Quiet badges!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Pen Pal Badge - EP 7
programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, earning their Pen Pal badges and making some new friends in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Big Day Out Badge - EP 8
programme.desc: Duggee takes the Squirrels and their parents on an exciting mystery trip to a surprising destination, where they learn they can make anywhere special and earn their Big Day Out badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Tree Badge - EP 9
programme.desc: Duggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live amongst them, and earn their tree badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ladybird's Gameshow - EP 9
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Campfire Choir - EP 10
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Time - EP 11
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Calm Down - EP 12
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Master of Puppets - EP 13
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Duck Cake - EP 43
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Handstand - EP 44
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna can't find a way to make herself useful. They're both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip - EP 45
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Ice Cream - EP 46
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a lick of each other's ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they don't notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind - EP 4
programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Hide-and-Seek, the Giant Pacific Octopus - EP 5
programme.desc: Bebefinn is playing hide and seek, just like the Giant Pacific Octopus does!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions S01 - Andy and the Tiger Cubs - EP 14
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve in India on a baby animal mission to track down a female tiger and her new born cubs. Along the way, our team outwit a sloth that strays dangerously close to the den where the cubs are resting.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge - EP 6
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Poll Position - EP 2
programme.desc: King Julien learns that 99% of the lemurs love him, so he makes it his mission to find and convert his one "hater."

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Booving In / Sant Oh - EP 1
programme.desc: Best friends Tip and Oh drive each other crazy when he moves into the human world with her./Oh stirs up trouble when he tries to act like Santa Claus.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Little Kisses / Snow Day - EP 2
programme.desc: Tip busts Oh eating kitty litter and says he'll never get kissed by My Mom again./Oh and Tip help out all his friends when they freeze into Boovsicles.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lotus - EP 3
programme.desc: Po's moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk (Zhen) out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Legend of Master Long-Tooth - EP 4
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writer's son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperor's Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission she's sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Gateway to The Desert - EP 5
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Dared Straight - EP 46
programme.desc: The kids take their "Dare Game" too far, causing Grug, Ugga, Phil and Hope to forbid them from playing it. But when the adults also get hooked on the game, the kids must convince them to stop before someone gets hurt.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Thunkless - EP 47
programme.desc: Thunk goes missing after the Thunder Sisters dismiss his help during a battle. The Thunder Sisters, and Grug, Phil, and Guy's newly formed "Thunder Sifters" search on and off the farm for Thunk.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Friday Nut Lights - EP 48
programme.desc: The Croods, Bettermans, and Guy compete in the Throw-Go-Bowl - an annual Throw-go-nut championship game against the punch monkeys. Grug's desire to win above all else threatens to push away his teammates.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Say Goodbye to Hollywood – part 2 - EP 50
programme.desc: Despite the Spy Racers’ best efforts, Dann is able to set off one of her earthquake devices causing all of L.A. to shake. Now it’s a race against the clock as they embark on their final mission to stop Dann and her super-soldiers for good!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Fugitives - EP 25
programme.desc: Now that they’re officially on the run, the team heads down to Mexico City to hide out in one of Ms. Nowhere’s many safe houses. With super-agent Palindrome and the police hot on their tales, they decide the only way they’re going to survive is by getting their hands on some money by winning an underground derby race.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - The Ocelot King vs. El Mariposa - EP 26
programme.desc: Unable to decide how to prove their innocence, the team has a huge fight! Ms. Nowhere and Echo Pearl reach out to Palindrome with the evidence they've collected while Tony and Cisco find Uncle Tuco at a lucha libra match, where Cisco must face the ultimate question: can you always trust family?

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Defenders Of The Wing Part 2 - EP 40
programme.desc: Hiccup, Mala, Astrid, Fishlegs, and Snotlout go searching for the now captured Eruptodon, but little do they know that Viggo has a sinister plan.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Gruff Around The Edges - EP 41
programme.desc: When a distant cousin of the Twins named Gruffnut arrives on Dragon's Edge, Tuffnut tries to impress him, but Gruffnut may not be the hero he seems.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Midnight Scrum - EP 42
programme.desc: When Viggo puts a bounty on Hiccup's head, every Dragon Hunter in the world is after capturing Hiccup, so Toothless and the Riders must rescue him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Into the Belly of the Den of the House of the Nest of Cats - EP 8
programme.desc: Mom tries to help Tim get over his fear of the neighborhood crazy-cat-lady

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Turn And Burn - EP 30
programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - The Good Surprise / Nightmare On Eep Street - EP 17
programme.desc: When Ugga's new surprise attack fails, and she comes home in a bad mood, Thunk tries to cure it by finding a happy surprise for his mom/ Eep stays up all night to see the mysterious and rare Night Mare (a horse with a rainbow mane) when she's teased for thinking they're not real.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Extreme Sleepover Club / Vega Swift - EP 41
programme.desc: Smidge, Guy, Cooper, and Biggie throw an impromptu sleepover in the Fun Factory. But when unexpected visitors show up, will they avoid getting in trouble?/ Satin and Chenille are tasked with babysitting Luna Swift, Nova’s toddler niece. But she proves to be a bit of a handful

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Spirit Day - EP 9
programme.desc: Mega Fat CEO Baby holds a game day at Baby Corp and Boss Baby must find a way to beat Mega Fat CEO Baby at his own game

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Par Avion - EP 10
programme.desc: When Mega Fat tries to get Boss Baby fired while on an airplane to Pairs, Tim and Staci must prevent a baby meltdown

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - As the Diaper Changes - EP 14
programme.desc: When Grandma Templeton comes to stay, she forces Boss Baby into Tim's room but they struggle to be roommates, and meanwhile, Baby Corp's new CEO trusts Boss Baby with the new Stinkless Serum

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Super Cool Big Kids Inc. - EP 15
programme.desc: Convinced old people are the new enemy, Boss Baby uses Tim to create havoc at the senior center, but a war soon begins when the seniors rally against babies

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong

Marlia tidak puas hati kerana Reez menarik balik laporan polis yang dibuat. Dia mahu Hans terus dibicarakan dan dimasukkan ke penjara. Marlia dan Rashid bergaduh hanya kerana Marlia masih mengharapkan Reez sedangkan Rashid mempertahankan Hans sebagai suami Ira. Rashid meninggalkan Marlia dan keluar dari rumah. Rashid tidur di rumah Imran. Ira menyalahkan Hans di atas pergaduhan ibu dan bapanya. Sementara itu Hans pulang ke rumah Pak Leh.

Sementara itu, Ryan berang lalu memukul Nita selepas rahsia perkahwinan mereka terbongkar kepada Dara. Akhirnya, Izz kembali ke rumah selepas segalanya terurai.

programme.title: Checklist Mr Rights
programme.desc: Nina mula melupakan Zach dan kembali aktif sebagai pempengaruh media sosial. Adam menemaninya meneroka Johor Bahru, sekali gus mengeratkan hubungan mereka walaupun ingatannya masih belum pulih.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel mencabar Irfan dan menggelarnya dayus kerana menghalang Sara ke reunion. Demi menjaga hati Sara, Irfan akhirnya mengalah. Namun dia terkilan masih belum dikurniakan zuriat. Sementara itu, rahsia lama Hussin mengundang dendam Dato Muiz. Menjelang harijadinya, Sara menerima hadiah mengejut daripada Airel.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik, Edora dan Johan bersemuka dengan Mak Seri Divain setelah mengetahui Mak Seri bakal melancarkan produk dengan konsep 'Kleopatrena' yang sama. Pujukan mereka tidak berjaya apabila Mak Seri enggan menukar konsepnya. Ana membuat keputusan untuk berjumpa Mak Seri yang membuatkan Edora cemburu manakala Taufik dan Johan berasa bangga apabila Mak Seri bersetuju untuk menukar konsepnya setelah berjaya dipujuk oleh Ana.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Musim sejuk tahun 1598, kisah pertempuran laut terakhir Yi Sun-shin semasa pencerobohan Jepun ke atas Korea, yang berlaku di Selat Noryang.

programme.title: Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orang-orang kecil kelas bawahan di FlatSimpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan,bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak. Mereka jugaberhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antaramereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orangpenghuni flat tersebut.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya…

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Agrinai
programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah terpencil, eksperimen psikologi jenayah dengan tiga pembunuh bersiri psikopat, mesin AI dan LSD yang kuat menjadi huru-hara apabila pembunuh melarikan diri, mengganas penduduk tempatan dan mendekati keluarganya, mendedahkan motif gelap dan kelainan yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Pelepas Saka
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. Mengikut legenda, apabila anda melihat kereta tersebut di lebuhraya, jangan sesekali memotongnya kerana kereta itu akan terus muncul di hadapan anda, dan yang lebih menakutkan, tiada pemandu yang dilihat mengemudi kereta tersebut.

programme.title: Alam Puaka EP1
programme.desc: Kisah-kisah yang dipaparkan di dalam siri ini adalah berdasarkan daripada penceritaan masyarakat umum. Ianya dilakonkan secara fiksyen dan sebarang penambahan tidak berkaitan dengan sesiapa samada hidup atau telah meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP8

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP5
programme.desc: Nerina menyaksikan manifestasi Syawal yang mengerikan, yang menyebabkannya menjadi tunduk dan patuh. Apabila Hamid mendedahkan kekejaman Puan Sri terhadap Bulan, kemarahan Riska memuncak.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP5
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ

Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Alif dan Tanwin, dua sahabat yang terlibat dengan sindiket mencuri kasut tetapi nekad untuk berubah ketika Ramadan dan memulakan hidup baru — namun perjalanan mereka berubah selepas terlibat kemalangan.

programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahan—dihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Sifu & Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Melawan Takdir

Ia mengangkat pengalaman hidupnya yang penuh cabaran sejak kecil — kehilangan orang tersayang, jatuh bangun dalam hidup, sampai berjaya jadi seorang sineas. Cerita ni tunjuk bagaimana semangat, doa, dan keyakinan boleh buat seseorang bangkit walaupun diuji dengan pelbagai takdir yang pahit.

Setelah kematian nenek, mereka berebut untuk memiliki cincin pusaka nenek yang kononnya mempunyai magis tertentu. Tetapi pelbagai halangan terjadi untuk mereka mewarisinya. Mampukah mereka menghadapi segala rintangan demi sebentuk cincin pusaka?

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai

Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: The Ex-files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Meng Yun and Yu Fei, are of marriageable age and are facing challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, while Fei and his girlfriend opt for a “marriage cooling-off period” to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father's heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau's wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: The Leakers
programme.desc: A deadly artificial virus erupts in Malaysia as a listed pharmaceutical company exploits its monopoly on the cure for huge profits, resorting to murder to silence anyone who gets too close. A Hong Kong superintendent and a Malaysian inspector team up with a journalist, aided by the hacker collective “The Leakers”, to expose the corporate-political conspiracy.

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin…

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Gopal Bhar
programme.desc: Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in King Krishnachandra's court. His wit and humour are well-known and his exploits always have a significant social message.

Sementara itu, Ryan berang lalu memukul Nita selepas rahsia perkahwinan mereka terbongkar kepada Dara. Akhirnya, Izz kembali ke rumah selepas segalanya terurai.

Hubungan mereka bermula secara profesional, namun perlahan-lahan berkembang menjadi sesuatu yang lebih kompleks, menguji batas emosi, kesunyian dan makna sebenar hubungan tanpa komitmen.

programme.desc: Ira minta bantuan Imran untuk menghalang Rashid dari berkahwin dengan Dija. Setelah dirisik, Imran akhirnya tahu antara Rashid dan Dija memang tidak ada sebarang hubungan. Sementara itu Hans terus berusaha untuk memastikan Ira menjalani terapi agar kakinya yang lumpuh dapat berjalan semula. Hans tidak peduli dengan makian dan perbuatan Ira yang kasar terhadapnya. Marlia pergi menemui Reez dan menuduh Reez menarik balik laporan polis terhadap Hans kerana dibayar oleh Imran atau Rashid. Reez menafikan.

programme.desc: Buntu mencari arah penulisan yang sesuai, Nina menerima pelbagai pandangan daripada Niesa dan Imran. Namun kata-kata Adam menyedarkannya bahawa karya terbaik lahir daripada kejujuran hati.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Sara meminta Airel berhenti mengganggu hidupnya, namun konflik memuncak apabila Airel muncul di reunion dan Irfan tersalah faham melihat mereka bersama. Walaupun Sara cuba menjelaskan, Irfan dikuasai cemburu dan ego, sehingga mengugut untuk menceraikannya. Mujur Hussin campur tangan sebelum keadaan menjadi lebih buruk.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Edora memecat Adriana tanpa persetujuan Taufik dan cuba mensabotaj Ana di hari pelancaran produk Kleopatrena tetapi berjaya dipatahkah oleh Johan dan Nani. Ana berjaya menukarkan fikiran para jemputan yang mula-mula skeptikal dengan pemilihannya sebagai duta produk dengan aura dan keyakinannya yang tersendiri. Edora cuba mengatasi kejayaan Ana dengan membuat pengumuman tentang perkahwinannya dengan Taufik.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP5
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ

programme.title: The Equalizer S3 EP9
programme.desc: McCall dan Dante diuji apabila seorang penjenayah berjuta-tahun menculik ahli keluarga seorang klien dan memaksa mereka bantu dalam rompakan.

programme.title: Let It Ghost
programme.desc: Sebuah antologi yang mengandungi tiga kisah hantu, menampilkan pelakon-pelakon yang sedang meningkat naik serta YouTuber tempatan yang popular.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya…

programme.title: PE3
programme.desc: Juga dikenali sebagai "PE-3", yang bermaksud Pelan No. 3, filem komedi aksi arahan Farid Kamil ini mengisahkan sekumpulan perompak berprofil tinggi di Pulau Pinang.

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: The Midwich Cuckoos EP2
programme.desc: Beberapa wanita disahkan hamil tanpa penjelasan. Ketegangan meningkat apabila kes ini menarik perhatian pihak luar.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP8
programme.desc: Lima pelajar Aqil, Nisa, Harith, Elina dan Zaki bermalam di sebuah banglo kolonial lama untuk menjalankan kajian tesis mengenai collective trauma. Namun sejak malam pertama,mereka mula mengalami kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: “Rajawali” mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP3

Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Abang Lejen
programme.desc: Dua beradik yang kehilangan ibu bapa mereka sejak kecil. Si abang sanggup mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi melindungi adiknya walau apa pun yang terjadi.

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahan—dihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Sifu & Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai “6 Jilake” ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.desc: Helo para guru dan murid-murid sekolah rendah di seluruh Indonesia! Uji pengetahuan dan ketangkasan dalam menjawab soalan dengan cepat dan tepat dalam Juara Indonesia.

Ketika memandu secara melulu, Laura melanggar gerai penjual nasi goreng, menyebabkan lelaki itu cedera dan dimasukkan ke hospital.

programme.desc: Set during the second Manchu invasion of Korea, Nam Yi, the best archer in Korea, goes up against the Qing Dynasty to rescue his younger sister Ja In - who was to be enslaved by the Manchurians.

programme.desc: Woo-seok in his 40's has always dreamt of going back to his high school days when he had the best days of his life. After an accident, he wakes up and finds himself in the year 1997...

programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.desc: A mysterious girl survived a blood raid in a secret lab found herself being tracked down by a group of assassins.

programme.title: CADAVER
programme.desc: 6 med students participate in their first anatomy class, yet nightmare begins when they are assigned with a deadly beautiful cadaver.

programme.title: CAFE MIDNIGHT
programme.desc: Yoon went searching for her groom Taeyoung who didn't show up on the wedding day. She arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight' by chance and found a younger Taeyoung from the past.

programme.title: COUNTDOWN (2023)
programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: SECOND SISTER
programme.desc: So-eun, grieving her sister's suicide after sexual harassment and cyberbullying, teams up with a private investigator Jun-gyeong to uncover the dark truth behind the malicious rumors.

programme.title: DEVILS
programme.desc: Jae-hwan is a detective catching the serial murderer Jin-hyeok and they have a physical struggle. When Jae-hwan wakes up in the hospital, he realized their bodies have been switched...

programme.title: OFFICE
programme.desc: The investigation following a sales manager brutally killing his entire family leads to a track of mystery and tragedy in an overwhelmed work team at Seoul.

programme.title: FOLLOWING
programme.desc: Real estate agent Jung-Tae has a penchant for spying. He discovers the death of the social media star So-Ra. He is falsely accused of murder and is determined to find the real culprit.

programme.title: THE NOISY MANSION
programme.desc: Geo-ul moves into the mysterious apartment plagued by unexplained floor noise. Determined to solve the mystery, she faces unexpected challenges while uncovering the apartment's secrets.

programme.title: A MELODY TO REMEMBER
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-Ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Hands Up 2026

The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mystic Nine & What's On Today
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."
