Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chun's surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with Nan since she met him once as a child. After graduating high school, Zhi realizes that she and Nan are in the same university, where they get to know each other by chance and become close friends. However, Zhi is still too shy to express her love for Nan. Will this long-term crush finally turn into true love?

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his son's clash with another student in school and his wife's intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Go for Broke
programme.desc: A ruthless drug trafficking group has destroyed countless families due to drug addiction, including Zhang Yao's family. Vowing to take revenge, Zhang Yao teams up with Detective An to take down the drug lords. As their revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person's subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.desc: Trendsetter bersama Zakuan Zainal menampilkan Alwis & Xavier dalam segmen Usya Kedai, manakala Izzat dari Bello & Co untuk Gaya & Kerjaya. Bagi segmen Bedah Kotak, perincian dan keunikan beg mewah Dior Saddle Bag akan dikupas secara terperinci.

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music & wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancanga/Siri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: TERBAIK DARI JALANAN
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke 54200 Breakfast, Restoran Kung Fu Ramen dan Rollo Mexican Food.

programme.title: 1001 RESEPI PERIUK NASI
programme.desc: Saksikan pelbagai cara menyediakan masak kegemaran semua dengan hanya mengunakan Periuk Nasi sahaja. Dalam episod ini Danny Aidil akan menyediakan masakan Hawai iaitu Loco Moco, Ayam Katsu Masubi & Udang Bawang Putih Berkrim.

programme.title: AROMA MASAK
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Sardin Telur & Popia Ro3 Tuna sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Issey Fazlisham.

programme.title: INSPIRASI
programme.desc: Inspirasi kali ini bersama Koay Hao Sheng dalam sebuah program temu bual yang menyelami kisah sebenar artis dan figura kreatif. Beliau berkongsi tentang jatuh bangun kehidupan, cabaran, dan kejayaan yang sarat dengan inspirasi, motivasi, serta pengajaran bermakna.

programme.title: LUBUK
programme.desc: Rancangan khas yang akan membawa anda ke tempat menarik dari sungai hinggalah ke tempat tersembunyi untuk memancing. Kali ni, kita ke lubuk memancing di Pulau Tioman, Pahang bersama Joe Aziz.

programme.title: SEMBANG SELEBRITI
programme.desc: Sembang selebriti merupakan rancangan bual bicara bersama selebriti yang menceritakan tentang pengalaman mereka di dalam dunia seni tanahair yang boleh dijadikan sumber inspirasi. Episod kali ini menampilkan Loco B sebagai selebriti jemputan.

programme.title: BAKAR
programme.desc: Bakar adalah sebuah rancangan memasak dengan kaedah bakar yang menggunakan ketuhar. Untuk episod kali ini, Chef Kim akan berkongsi dengan penonton, cara menyediakan Ikan Bakar bersama Sos Lemon, Biskut Coklat Malta & Kek Tembikai Laici.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Sara meminta Airel berhenti mengganggu hidupnya, namun konflik memuncak apabila Airel muncul di reunion dan Irfan tersalah faham melihat mereka bersama. Walaupun Sara cuba menjelaskan, Irfan dikuasai cemburu dan ego, sehingga mengugut untuk menceraikannya. Mujur Hussin campur tangan sebelum keadaan menjadi lebih buruk.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Edora memecat Adriana tanpa persetujuan Taufik dan cuba mensabotaj Ana di hari pelancaran produk Kleopatrena tetapi berjaya dipatahkah oleh Johan dan Nani. Ana berjaya menukarkan fikiran para jemputan yang mula-mula skeptikal dengan pemilihannya sebagai duta produk dengan aura dan keyakinannya yang tersendiri. Edora cuba mengatasi kejayaan Ana dengan membuat pengumuman tentang perkahwinannya dengan Taufik.

programme.title: Sid & Aya (Not A Love Story)
programme.desc: Sid, seorang lelaki korporat yang kesepian, bertemu Aya, gadis misteri yang menawarkan “perkhidmatan menemani” tanpa melibatkan cinta. Hubungan mereka bermula secara profesional, namun perlahan-lahan berkembang menjadi sesuatu yang lebih kompleks, menguji batas emosi, kesunyian dan makna sebenar hubungan tanpa komitmen.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Kerana terlalu marah Marlia menampar Dija. Imran tidak setuju dengan tindakan Marlia yang keterlaluan dan memalukan itu. Rashid akhirnya mengajak Marlia bercuti untuk meredakan kemarahan Marlia. Marlia gembira dan membuat persiapan dengan membeli baju baru sekalipun dia masih tidak tahu ke mana Rashid akan membawanya. Sementara itu Hans memberitahu Ira yang dia yakin Ira pasti akan menerima cintanya. Tetapi Ira dengan sombongnya yakin yang dia membenci Hans selama-lamanya. Dia cuma menganggap Hans hanya sebagai orang gaji yang halal untuknya. Pelbagai cara Hans lakukan untuk menghiburkan Ira sehingga Ira tidak mampu menahan bibirnya dari mengukir senyum dengan telatah Hans. Marlia terperanjat apabila Rashid hanya membawanya bercuti ke sebuah perkampungan kecil. Jauh dari jangkauannya yang dia akan dibawa bercuti ke luar negara! Marlia semakin tertekan apabila mengetahui bahawa Dija yang merancang dan menguruskan percutian kampung itu!

programme.title: Checklist Mr Rights
programme.desc: Hubungan Nina dan Adam semakin rapat. Namun Nina kecewa apabila menyangka Adam menggunakan senarai ciri-ciri lelaki idamannya untuk mempermainkan perasaannya. Dia nekad pulang ke Kuala Lumpur.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Hubungan Sara dan Irfan semakin retak apabila ego dan salah faham berterusan. Sara kehilangan fokus kerja hingga dilucutkan jawatan lalu pulang ke kampung. Hussin menyelamatkannya daripada cubaan langgar lari dan hubungan mereka mula pulih. Damia hampir bersalin, namun Airel masih enggan bertanggungjawab.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik melantik Nani untuk menggantikan tempat Adriana setelah Adriana menolak untuk kembali ke syarikat. Ana ditemani oleh Johan untuk aktiviti promosi pertamanya. Ana bersedih apabila dia menimbulkan publisiti buruk kerana enggan bergambar dengan seorang peminat yang mendapat liputan meluas.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP6
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful AzmiJamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Menara Tinjau terletak Bukit Ampang tidak jauh dari Kuala Lumpur. Kawasan ini di bawah pengawasan Jabatan Perhutanan yang telah dibuka pada 2006. Dua orang Renjen Perhutanan berkongsi maklumat, terdapat mayat dibunuh dan dibuang di situ juga pengamal perubatan menjalankan aktiviti. Mereka pernah diganggu dengan lembaga Pocong yang menakutkan dan bau busuk semasa bertugas pada waktu malam. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi dan bau busuk yang menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: The Equalizer S3 EP10
programme.desc: McCall perlu selesaikan situasi tebusan hospital setelah seorang ibu cuba selamatkan anaknya yang sakit dengan tindakan ekstrem.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP7
programme.desc: Keadaan menjadi semakin tidak terkawal apabila tuduhan dan ketakutan memecahbelahkan komuniti.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Flat Simpang Satu
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan dan perjuangan orang-orang kecil kelas bawahan di FlatSimpang Satu yang berlegar dalam himpitan pola kehidupan,bergelumang dalam jalur ekonomi dan politik sesak. Mereka jugaberhadapan dengan perasaan curiga dan mencurigai antaramereka serta kejadian aneh dan menyeramkan yang dilalui oleh 3 orangpenghuni flat tersebut.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Musim sejuk tahun 1598, kisah pertempuran laut terakhir Yi Sun-shin semasa pencerobohan Jepun ke atas Korea, yang berlaku di Selat Noryang.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. Mengikut legenda, apabila anda melihat kereta tersebut di lebuhraya, jangan sesekali memotongnya kerana kereta itu akan terus muncul di hadapan anda, dan yang lebih menakutkan, tiada pemandu yang dilihat mengemudi kereta tersebut.

programme.title: Agrinai
programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah terpencil, eksperimen psikologi jenayah dengan tiga pembunuh bersiri psikopat, mesin AI dan LSD yang kuat menjadi huru-hara apabila pembunuh melarikan diri, mengganas penduduk tempatan dan mendekati keluarganya, mendedahkan motif gelap dan kelainan yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: PE3
programme.desc: Juga dikenali sebagai "PE-3", yang bermaksud Pelan No. 3, filem komedi aksi arahan Farid Kamil ini mengisahkan sekumpulan perompak berprofil tinggi di Pulau Pinang.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP8
programme.desc: Lima pelajar Aqil, Nisa, Harith, Elina dan Zaki bermalam di sebuah banglo kolonial lama untuk menjalankan kajian tesis mengenai collective trauma. Namun sejak malam pertama,mereka mula mengalami kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda yang taksub dengan gajet perlu berdepan dengan bayang-bayang masa lalunya demi membebaskan diri daripada entiti ghaib yang telah menguasai telefonnya.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP4
programme.desc: Mengisahkan lima sahabat yang terlepas tren selepas terlalu lama berbincang di sebuah kafe berhampiran stesen. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad (Que Haidar), penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Seorang pakar psikiatri yang tidak konvensional merawat CHOI, seorang lelaki yang takut untuk tidur dan tidak mampu membezakan antara mimpi dengan realiti.

programme.desc: Pegawai polis hebat Hong Kong itu perlu menghentikan sekumpulan pengebom yang melakukan pemerasan, sementara musuh-musuh daripada filem *Police Story* (1985) pula mahu membalas dendam.

Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai “6 Jilake” ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Mamak Cupcake
programme.desc: MJ ialah seorang keturunan mamak kelahiran Pulau Pinang yang bersemangat dalam membuat kek cawan. Namun, bapanya menghalang kemajuannya kerana mahu MJ mewarisi perniagaannya.

programme.title: Jhangri
programme.desc: Jhangri ialah filem komedi romantik aksi penuh dengan suspens, kejutan dan plot twist. Ia mengisahkan perjalanan Vikran yang cuba menawan hati Jaanu, gadis yang sepatutnya dijodohkan dengannya tetapi menolak tanpa sebab jelas. Apabila rahsia penolakan itu terbongkar, kisah bertukar daripada romantik komedi kepada aksi suspens

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.title: Rock Bro!
programme.desc: Kisah kumpulan rock Rimba Bara meneruskan perjuangan mereka dalam industri muzik, namun konflik muncul apabila Jijoe jatuh cinta kepada legenda rock Ella dan menyebabkan band itu retak serta menimbulkan cabaran baru dalam kerjaya dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Nun Mati Bertemu Alif
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Alif dan Tanwin, dua sahabat yang terlibat dengan sindiket mencuri kasut tetapi nekad untuk berubah ketika Ramadan dan memulakan hidup baru — namun perjalanan mereka berubah selepas terlibat kemalangan.

programme.title: Kaki Kitai
programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Abang Lejen
programme.desc: Dua beradik yang kehilangan ibu bapa mereka sejak kecil. Si abang sanggup mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi melindungi adiknya walau apa pun yang terjadi.

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahan—dihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Sifu & Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Rudy Habibie
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan hidup Rudy Habibie ketika menuntut di Jerman Barat. Di sebalik cabaran sebagai pelajar dan peribadi, beliau gigih mengejar impian untuk menjadi jurutera bertaraf dunia dan membawa kemajuan industri penerbangan demi masa depan Indonesia

programme.desc: Ica dan Rama dikejutkan dengan kedatangan Maya semasa pembukaan klinik kecantikan mereka. Maya cemburu kerana pelanggannya berkurangan dan menganggap klinik Ica sebagai pesaing. Selepas itu, Ica menerima pelbagai ancaman hingga klinik hampir ditutup. Ica mengesyaki Maya, tetapi Maya menafikan. Siapakah sebenarnya dalang di sebalik gangguan itu?

programme.title: D'Academy 8
programme.desc: D'Academy 8 kembali dengan generasi baharu penyanyi dangdut berbakat yang bersaing untuk menjadi sensasi muzik seterusnya di Indonesia. Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

programme.title: A MELODY TO REMEMBER
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-Ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: MY LOVE, MY BRIDE
programme.desc: Youngmin and Miyoung experienced struggles in their marriage soon after the honeymoon period. As they try to sort things out, they learn the true meaning of love.

programme.title: PROJECT WOLF HUNTING
programme.desc: During the extradition to Korea, a group of dangerous criminals united to stage an escape from the floating prison.

programme.title: HEARTMAN: ROCK AND LOVE
programme.desc: Seung-min, a former rock singer scarred by a humiliating past, reunites with his first love Bo-na. As romance sparks again, hidden secrets and old wounds threaten their second chance.

programme.title: UNFORGETTABLE
programme.desc: A radio DJ receives a letter written 23 years ago in the past. Through the letter, the story of his first love and the friendships of five friends are revealed.

programme.title: THE WITCH: PART 2. THE OTHER ONE
programme.desc: A mysterious girl survived a blood raid in a secret lab found herself being tracked down by a group of assassins.

programme.title: THE CHILDE
programme.desc: A Kopino boxer goes to Korea to search for his estranged father for his mother's surgery, but his surroundings have turned into a mess after he met a mysterious man known as "Nobleman"...

programme.title: SINGLE IN SEOUL
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: WAR OF THE ARROWS
programme.desc: Set during the second Manchu invasion of Korea, Nam Yi, the best archer in Korea, goes up against the Qing Dynasty to rescue his younger sister Ja In - who was to be enslaved by the Manchurians.

programme.title: MY LOVE, MY BRIDE
programme.desc: Youngmin and Miyoung experienced struggles in their marriage soon after the honeymoon period. As they try to sort things out, they learn the true meaning of love.

programme.title: HI-FIVE
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: HELLO GHOST
programme.desc: After many failed suicide attempts, a man discovers he can see a family of ghosts. The ghosts agree to leave him alone under the condition that he fulfill their requests.

programme.title: THE ULTIMATE DUO
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.title: COUNTDOWN (2023)
programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel & What's On Today
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person's subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva's mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother's wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva's heart?

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say “yes”?

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sect's Zhang Chui Shan's son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue…

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan…

programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang komikus yang terikat dengan kisah silamnya, bertemu dengan sekumpulan anak band yang turut mencari makna hidup mereka. Perjalanan mereka merungkai masa lalu sambil berdepan konflik, persahabatan dan emosi yang mengubah hidup.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Marlia menuduh Rashid sengaja membawa dia bercuti di homestay kampung untuk membuatkan dia gila supaya Rashid boleh berkahwin dengan Dija. Marlia pergi ke pejabat dan memarahi Dija. Dija menafikan dia terlibat dalam pemilihan lokasi percutian. Dija melawan Marlia. Imran pula marah apabila melihat Dija melawan Marlia. Imran terus memaksa Dija berhenti kerja serta merta. Rashid kecewa dengan apa yang berlaku dan simpati kepada Dija yang menjadi mangsa. Di rumah, Hans dipaksa tidur di luar bilik kerana Marlia nak tidur bersama Ira. Pelbagai cara dilakukan oleh Hans hanya untuk menambat hatti Ira. Marlia mula curiga apabila Ira sudah boleh tersenyum dengan telatah Hans. Marlia cuba menggantikan tempat Dija sebagai Pembantu peribadi dan setiausaha kepada Rashid. Malangnya sikap kasar dan ego Marlia membuatkan keadaan di pejabat semakin huru hara.

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Rojak adalah sebuah rancangan yang membawa pelbagai jenis informasi yang mendedahkan orang awam kepada benda yang mereka tidak biasanya akan cuba dari eksperimen sosial, D.I.Y. dan lain-lain lagi. Dihoskan oleh Leaism.

programme.title: K-Love
programme.desc: Tish mengaku kepada Jay yang dia menyukainya sejak zaman kanak-kanak, Val sangat memerlukan gaun untuk Majlis Tari-Menari Tatler manakala Shiela tertanya-tanya kenapa David berada dalam mood yang tak baik dengannya.

programme.title: Checklist Mr Rights
programme.desc: Nina kembali ke Kuala Lumpur dan cuba memulihkan hubungannya dengan keluarga serta Niesa. Di Johor, Imran terus menyusahkan Adam sementara Niesa berusaha menyatukan semula persahabatan mereka.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia gembira apabila Airel akhirnya menunjukkan sedikit tanggungjawab dan bersetuju menunggu keputusan ujian DNA selepas bayi lahir. DS Johari dan Dato Muiz lega melihat perubahan itu. Di kampung, Tokma menyerahkan cincin pusaka kepada Sara sebagai simbol rumah tangganya dengan Irfan. Walaupun saling merindui, Irfan dan Sara masih dibatasi ego. Sementara itu, Ben membongkar rancangan Dato Muiz kepada Hussin. Kemuncaknya, Airel yang marah kerana Sara kehilangan kerja datang menyerang Irfan dan menyalahkannya atas segala yang berlaku.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Populariti Ana mula melonjak naik setelah Taufik meminta Johan membantu Ana memuat naik gambar-gambar aktiviti Ana di laman-laman sosial miliknya. Edora cemburu apabila tahu Taufik menemani Ana dalam sesi jelajahnya ke Ipoh. Taufik pula cemburu melihat respon Ana setiap kali menerima mesej atau panggilan dari Johan dan pura-pura berbual mesra dengan Edora. Ana yang tidak sedar dia juga cemburu, menerima pelawaan seorang VIP untuk keluar dengannya.

programme.title: Police Story II
programme.desc: Pegawai polis hebat Hong Kong itu perlu menghentikan sekumpulan pengebom yang melakukan pemerasan, sementara musuh-musuh daripada filem *Police Story* (1985) pula mahu membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP5
programme.desc: Nerina menyaksikan manifestasi Syawal yang mengerikan, yang menyebabkannya menjadi tunduk dan patuh. Apabila Hamid mendedahkan kekejaman Puan Sri terhadap Bulan, kemarahan Riska memuncak.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP5
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful Azmi Jamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di sebuah banglo lama yang dikatakan penuh mistri terletak di Branang, Selangor. En. Solo Ambush seorang penjejak paranormal menemami perantara. Banglo ini pernah didiami oleh sebuah keluarga Cina, disebabkan berlaku beberapa kejadian misteri dan menakutkan, mereka berpindah keluar. Pengantara bersama Solo Ambush, berserta krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan. Namun tiada lembaga yang muncul. Solo Ambush berkongsi pengalaman semasa menjalankan siasatan di situ

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Brick Mansion

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Sifu & Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Rudy Habibie

Ia mengisahkan perjalanan Vikran yang cuba menawan hati Jaanu, gadis yang sepatutnya dijodohkan dengannya tetapi menolak tanpa sebab jelas. Apabila rahsia penolakan itu terbongkar, kisah bertukar daripada romantik komedi kepada aksi suspens

Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: Tetangga Julid Bikin Hidupku Sulit
programme.desc: Ica dan Rama dikejutkan dengan kedatangan Maya semasa pembukaan klinik kecantikan mereka. Maya cemburu kerana pelanggannya berkurangan dan menganggap klinik Ica sebagai pesaing. Selepas itu, Ica menerima pelbagai ancaman hingga klinik hampir ditutup. Ica mengesyaki Maya, tetapi Maya menafikan. Siapakah sebenarnya dalang di sebalik gangguan itu?

programme.title: D'Academy 8
programme.desc: D'Academy 8 kembali dengan generasi baharu penyanyi dangdut berbakat yang bersaing untuk menjadi sensasi muzik seterusnya di Indonesia. Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Teka Teki Kematian Ibuku
programme.desc: Tamara (Intan Paramitha) ialah seorang wanita berjaya yang memiliki perniagaan kedai emas. Tanpa pengetahuannya, suaminya, Arya (Aditya Herpavi), menjalinkan hubungan sulit dengan pekerjanya, Ema. Sejak itu, Tamara mula mengalami pelbagai kejadian misteri sehingga akhirnya ditemui meninggal dunia. Kematiannya menimbulkan tanda tanya dan mendorong kedua-dua anaknya untuk mencari kebenaran.

programme.title: COUNTDOWN (2023)
programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: SALMOKJI: WHISPERING WATER
programme.desc: After an unidentified figure appears in the footage of Salmokji Reservoir, producer Su-in leads her crew to reshoot the site, only to encounter something lurking in the deep, dark water...

programme.title: WAITING FOR RAIN
programme.desc: An unmotivated student regains his passion for life after exchanging letters with his childhood friend and promise to meet if it rains on December 31st each year.

programme.title: OFFICE
programme.desc: The investigation following a sales manager brutally killing his entire family leads to a track of mystery and tragedy in an overwhelmed work team at Seoul.

programme.title: HELLO GHOST
programme.desc: After many failed suicide attempts, a man discovers he can see a family of ghosts. The ghosts agree to leave him alone under the condition that he fulfill their requests.

programme.title: ROLLING
programme.desc: Juri with depression is stuck at home during COVID. As her mother went visit Juri's grandmother, Juri has to run their Kimbap restaurant until her mother returns.

programme.title: TAZZA: THE HIDDEN CARD
programme.desc: Go-ni's nephew, Ham Dae-gil, enters the gambling underworld only to be used as a scapegoat in a deal gone wrong. Now he's planning his revenge by entering one big fatal game.

programme.title: THE NOISY MANSION
programme.desc: Geo-ul moves into the mysterious apartment plagued by unexplained floor noise. Determined to solve the mystery, she faces unexpected challenges while uncovering the apartment's secrets.

programme.title: CAFE MIDNIGHT
programme.desc: Yoon went searching for her groom Taeyoung who didn't show up on the wedding day. She arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight' by chance and found a younger Taeyoung from the past.

programme.title: WORST WOMAN
programme.desc: Eun-hee is an actress with poor acting and she acts in her life. She creates different characters when she dates a man. Eventually, her lies are tangled up and everything is messed up...

programme.title: THE WITCH: PART 2. THE OTHER ONE
programme.desc: A mysterious girl survived a blood raid in a secret lab found herself being tracked down by a group of assassins.
