programme.title: DEVILS
programme.desc: Jae-hwan is a detective catching the serial murderer Jin-hyeok and they have a physical struggle. When Jae-hwan wakes up in the hospital, he realized their bodies have been switched...

programme.title: SINGLE IN SEOUL
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set in 4 different eras in China, the 4-part anthology about 'home and country' is directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng and Shen Teng, who also star in their own story. The movie depicts how the 'fathers' forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the 'fighting' spirit through generations.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighbouring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan…

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out…

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia gembira apabila Airel akhirnya menunjukkan sedikit tanggungjawab dan bersetuju menunggu keputusan ujian DNA selepas bayi lahir. DS Johari dan Dato Muiz lega melihat perubahan itu. Di kampung, Tokma menyerahkan cincin pusaka kepada Sara sebagai simbol rumah tangganya dengan Irfan. Walaupun saling merindui, Irfan dan Sara masih dibatasi ego. Sementara itu, Ben membongkar rancangan Dato Muiz kepada Hussin. Kemuncaknya, Airel yang marah kerana Sara kehilangan kerja datang menyerang Irfan dan menyalahkannya atas segala yang berlaku.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Populariti Ana mula melonjak naik setelah Taufik meminta Johan membantu Ana memuat naik gambar-gambar aktiviti Ana di laman-laman sosial miliknya. Edora cemburu apabila tahu Taufik menemani Ana dalam sesi jelajahnya ke Ipoh. Taufik pula cemburu melihat respon Ana setiap kali menerima mesej atau panggilan dari Johan dan pura-pura berbual mesra dengan Edora. Ana yang tidak sedar dia juga cemburu, menerima pelawaan seorang VIP untuk keluar dengannya.

programme.title: Tomorrow Morning
programme.desc: Sebuah muzikal romantik yang mengikuti kehidupan sepasang kekasih dalam dua garis masa berbeza, hari perkahwinan mereka dan sepuluh tahun kemudian ketika berdepan perceraian. Kisah ini menyelami cinta, perkahwinan dan pilihan hidup.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Hans bawa Mak Biah pergi berjumpa Siti yang bekerja di kedai kasut Kamal. Siti gembira dapat bertemu dengan mak Biah yang dia rindui. Marlia marah kerana Hans membawa Mak Biah pergi tanpa kebenaran darinya sebagai tuan rumah. Marlia juga mengingatkan yang Hans juga bukan tuan nyang boleh buat sesuka hati di rumah itu. Sementara itu Imran mula rasa bersalah kerana dia memberhentikan Dija bekerja. Dalam diam Imran mula menyukai Dija. Hans meminta izin Marlia untuk memanggilnya 'mama' tetapi Marlia terus memarahi dan menghina Hans. Imran memberitahu Marlia yang dia sudah bersedia untuk berkahwin tetapi belum bersedia untuk membawa bakal isteri berjumpa Marlia. Ketika Imran melayan anak Dija di pusat membelibelah, tiba-tiba Marlia muncul di depannya!

Marlia marah kerana Hans membawa Mak Biah pergi tanpa kebenaran darinya sebagai tuan rumah. Marlia juga mengingatkan yang Hans juga bukan tuan nyang boleh buat sesuka hati di rumah itu. Sementara itu Imran mula rasa bersalah kerana dia memberhentikan Dija bekerja. Dalam diam Imran mula menyukai Dija. Hans meminta izin Marlia untuk memanggilnya 'mama' tetapi Marlia terus memarahi dan menghina Hans. Imran memberitahu Marlia yang dia sudah bersedia untuk berkahwin tetapi belum bersedia untuk membawa bakal isteri berjumpa Marlia. Ketika Imran melayan anak Dija di pusat membelibelah, tiba-tiba Marlia muncul di depannya!

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Airel terus mengambil peluang untuk mendekati Sara yang tinggal di rumah Tok Mah selepas berselisih faham dengan Irfan, namun Sara tetap setia dan tidak melayannya. Dalam masa yang sama, Dato Muiz ditahan polis atas tuduhan cuba mencederakan Sara. Tok Mah yang semakin uzur berusaha menyatukan semula Irfan dan Sara dengan menasihati kedua-duanya agar saling memaafkan. Sementara itu, Damia selamat melahirkan bayi lelaki, dan Airel akhirnya berdepan hakikat bahawa bayi tersebut adalah anak kandungnya.

programme.title: Titi Kayu
programme.desc: Alim, seorang pemuda Cina Peranakan yang disenangi penduduk kampung atas sikap ringan tulang, mengorbankan masa dan tenaga demi membina titi kayu bersama seorang budak bernama Umar, meskipun tidak mendapat sokongan ketua kampung.

programme.title: Siccin 7
programme.desc: Terpaksa meninggalkan kerjayanya sebagai doktor dan melarikan diri akibat satu 'perjanjian berdarah' dengan sindiket mafia yang mengeksploitasi kanak-kanak pengemis, Kemal berpindah bersama keluarganya ke rumah agam milik bapa saudaranya.

programme.title: The Hidden Hand (Dia Perempuan Sialan) EP6
programme.desc: Riska melakukan manipulasi psikologi terhadap Nerina selepas satu pertemuan ngeri pada tengah malam, sehingga membuatkan Nerina meragui kewarasan dirinya sendiri. Kunjungan Afidah yang tegang berakhir dengan pertengkaran hebat berhubung soal harta pusaka.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP6
programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful AzmiJamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Menara Tinjau terletak Bukit Ampang tidak jauh dari Kuala Lumpur. Kawasan ini di bawah pengawasan Jabatan Perhutanan yang telah dibuka pada 2006. Dua orang Renjen Perhutanan berkongsi maklumat, terdapat mayat dibunuh dan dibuang di situ juga pengamal perubatan menjalankan aktiviti. Mereka pernah diganggu dengan lembaga Pocong yang menakutkan dan bau busuk semasa bertugas pada waktu malam. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi dan bau busuk yang menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan.

programme.title: Bunohan
programme.desc: 3 abang pulang ke kampung Bunohan dengan tiga alasan yang sangat berbeza; mereka akan menemui kematian, penipuan dan wahyu yang sangat suram.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang Fahmi (Johan As'ari) yang amat mencintai isterinya Riana (Aishah Ilias) dan dia tidak dapat menerima kenyataan bahawa isterinya sudah meninggal dunia. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Pelepas Saka
programme.desc: Selepas bapanya, seorang ketua jenayah Vietnam yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat dibunuh secara kejam, tanpa diduga menjadi sasaran sindiket saingan. Terpaksa melangkah ke dunia berbahaya yang selalu dielakkannya.

programme.title: Volkswagen Kuning
programme.desc: Filem ini diilhamkan oleh legenda urban terkenal Malaysia mengenai sebuah Volkswagen berwarna kuning yang misteri yang dilihat di Lebuhraya Karak. Mengikut legenda, apabila anda melihat kereta tersebut di lebuhraya, jangan sesekali memotongnya kerana kereta itu akan terus muncul di hadapan anda, dan yang lebih menakutkan, tiada pemandu yang dilihat mengemudi kereta tersebut.

Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk "Jangan Bernafas". Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai "footage" menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan hidup Rudy Habibie ketika menuntut di Jerman Barat. Di sebalik cabaran sebagai pelajar dan peribadi, beliau gigih mengejar impian untuk menjadi jurutera bertaraf dunia dan membawa kemajuan industri penerbangan demi masa depan Indonesia

programme.desc: MJ ialah seorang keturunan mamak kelahiran Pulau Pinang yang bersemangat dalam membuat kek cawan. Namun, bapanya menghalang kemajuannya kerana mahu MJ mewarisi perniagaannya.

programme.title: Jhangri
programme.desc: Jhangri ialah filem komedi romantik aksi penuh dengan suspens, kejutan dan plot twist. Ia mengisahkan perjalanan Vikran yang cuba menawan hati Jaanu, gadis yang sepatutnya dijodohkan dengannya tetapi menolak tanpa sebab jelas. Apabila rahsia penolakan itu terbongkar, kisah bertukar daripada romantik komedi kepada aksi suspens

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.title: Rock Bro!
programme.desc: Kisah kumpulan rock Rimba Bara meneruskan perjuangan mereka dalam industri muzik, namun konflik muncul apabila Jijoe jatuh cinta kepada legenda rock Ella dan menyebabkan band itu retak serta menimbulkan cabaran baru dalam kerjaya dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Nun Mati Bertemu Alif
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Alif dan Tanwin, dua sahabat yang terlibat dengan sindiket mencuri kasut tetapi nekad untuk berubah ketika Ramadan dan memulakan hidup baru — namun perjalanan mereka berubah selepas terlibat kemalangan.

programme.title: Kaki Kitai
programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Abang Lejen
programme.desc: Dua beradik yang kehilangan ibu bapa mereka sejak kecil. Si abang sanggup mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi melindungi adiknya walau apa pun yang terjadi.

programme.title: Rumput Tetangga
programme.desc: Kirana, seorang suri rumah yang pernah menjadi pelajar cemerlang, berasa tidak puas hati dengan kehidupannya. Selepas mendapat peluang misteri untuk menjadi wanita kerjaya yang berjaya, dia mula menyedari bahawa kehidupan yang diimpikan tidak semestinya membawa kebahagiaan tanpa keluarga tersayang.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: D'Academy 8
programme.desc: D'Academy 8 kembali dengan generasi baharu penyanyi dangdut berbakat yang bersaing untuk menjadi sensasi muzik seterusnya di Indonesia. Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

Keadaan menjadi rumit apabila Bagus cuba mendekati guru lain bernama Indri, menyebabkan Siska marah. Mampukah hubungan ayah dan anak ini pulih dan saling merestui pilihan masing-masing?

programme.title: Tiba-Tiba Kuis
programme.desc: Program kuiz kejutan di tengah keramaian yang menawarkan hadiah wang tunai lumayan. Orang ramai dipilih secara rawak untuk menjawab soalan mudah, sementara reaksi spontan dan kisah menyentuh mereka dirakam bagi menghasilkan hiburan yang menyeronokkan serta penuh makna.

programme.title: Water Games
programme.desc: Sekumpulan peserta bertanding dalam pelbagai cabaran dalam satu permainan air, dengan impian memenangi hadiah utama.

programme.title: SINGLE IN SEOUL
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: HI-FIVE
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: HITMAN: AGENT JUN
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online.

programme.title: WHISPERING CORRIDORS 6
programme.desc: Returning to her alma mater as vice-principal, Eun-hee who's plagued by lost memories joins a bullied student to uncover the dark truth behind a haunted restroom and a long-buried tragedy.

programme.title: WAR OF THE ARROWS
programme.desc: Set during the second Manchu invasion of Korea, Nam Yi, the best archer in Korea, goes up against the Qing Dynasty to rescue his younger sister Ja In - who was to be enslaved by the Manchurians.

programme.title: MY LOVE, MY BRIDE
programme.desc: Youngmin and Miyoung experienced struggles in their marriage soon after the honeymoon period. As they try to sort things out, they learn the true meaning of love.

programme.title: A MELODY TO REMEMBER
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-Ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: CADAVER
programme.desc: 6 med students participate in their first anatomy class, yet nightmare begins when they are assigned with a deadly beautiful cadaver.

programme.title: ROLLING
programme.desc: Juri with depression is stuck at home during COVID. As her mother went visit Juri's grandmother, Juri has to run their Kimbap restaurant until her mother returns.

programme.title: HITMAN: AGENT JUN
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online.

programme.title: WAITING FOR RAIN
programme.desc: An unmotivated student regains his passion for life after exchanging letters with his childhood friend and promise to meet if it rains on December 31st each year.

programme.title: THE ULTIMATE DUO
programme.desc: Jae-hyuk teams up with rookie detective Joong-ho. They arrest a thief and discover he may be a culprit of a closed case. They reopen the case yet the investigation runs into obstacles...

programme.title: FOLLOWING
programme.desc: Real estate agent Jung-Tae has a penchant for spying. He discovers the death of the social media star So-Ra. He is falsely accused of murder and is determined to find the real culprit.

programme.title: THE CHILDE
programme.desc: A Kopino boxer goes to Korea to search for his estranged father for his mother's surgery, but his surroundings have turned into a mess after he met a mysterious man known as "Nobleman"...

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: War Of Thorns & What's On Today
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING (CHEUNG KA FAI) and the loafer, JIAN, (CHIN KA LOK) always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIAN`s teacher, SUN (LIU KAI CHI) to death. They even make the banker, HUNG (LAW LOK LAU)`s business bankrupted and HUNG`s daughter, PO, (CHEUNG YUK SHAN) has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER)`s female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent `The First Tooth`. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agent`s reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHING`s talent together with JIAN and LUN`s assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as `The Virgin Courtesan`, `The Twins` and `The Nice Weather` etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying (Yoyo Chen) “committed suicide”, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung (Tavia Yeung) somehow obtains Tsz-ying's diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her “nice sisters” Lai Yi-wan (Rosina Lam), Lam Fung-yee (Elaine Yiu), Leung Fei-nga (Kelly Fu) and Lam On-on (Judy Kwong). To uncover the truth and avenge her friend's death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film “The Rose” as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang (Moses Chan) over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-ying's secret lover Lee Tak-lung (Kenneth Ma) and uses a series of “accidents” that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-ying's death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyone's glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Mystic Nine & What's On Today
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.desc: A warm and relatable lifestyle talk show that explores the daily dynamics between mothers, daughters-in-law, and modern families. Through real stories, lighthearted conversations, and practical tips on relationships, parenting, and home life, the program highlights touching and humorous moments.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into "haunted flats", which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of 'Tales From The Occult', the movie features three short stories about two high school friends, a magician undergoing hypnosis to find her missing friend, and a man finding his way out of a mysterious building. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis?

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmer's role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Busted Water Pipes
programme.desc: With crime almost non-existent in town, the police face the axe. To save their jobs, officer Yu Da Hai stages a fake robbery for his team to heroically foil. Unbeknownst to him, a gang of tomb raiders is tunnelling towards buried treasure beneath the station. When a water pipe bursts, chaos erupts and the line between cops and crooks blurs.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, she is left alone at home when her husband is away on a work trip. An intruder enters Bo's house and takes her hostage. As Bo tries to survive his mental and psychological torture, she discovers her husband's secret which is related to the accident leading to her blindness…

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih

Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Rumput Tetangga
programme.desc: Kirana, seorang suri rumah yang pernah menjadi pelajar cemerlang, berasa tidak puas hati dengan kehidupannya. Selepas mendapat peluang misteri untuk menjadi wanita kerjaya yang berjaya, dia mula menyedari bahawa kehidupan yang diimpikan tidak semestinya membawa kebahagiaan tanpa keluarga tersayang.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Hayya 2: Dream Hope And Reality
programme.desc: Filem sekuel ini menyorot trauma dan kehilangan. Hayya melarikan diri ke Indonesia lalu bertemu Lia dan Faisal, yang akhirnya menganggapnya sebagai pengikat rumah tangga mereka. Sementara Rahmat, Adhin dan Ricis terus mencarinya, rahsia keluarga Faisal terbongkar hingga tragedi besar berlaku.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Rudy Habibie
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan hidup Rudy Habibie ketika menuntut di Jerman Barat. Di sebalik cabaran sebagai pelajar dan peribadi, beliau gigih mengejar impian untuk menjadi jurutera bertaraf dunia dan membawa kemajuan industri penerbangan demi masa depan Indonesia

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.title: Mamak Cupcake
programme.desc: MJ ialah seorang keturunan mamak kelahiran Pulau Pinang yang bersemangat dalam membuat kek cawan. Namun, bapanya menghalang kemajuannya kerana mahu MJ mewarisi perniagaannya.

programme.title: Jhangri
programme.desc: Jhangri ialah filem komedi romantik aksi penuh dengan suspens, kejutan dan plot twist. Ia mengisahkan perjalanan Vikran yang cuba menawan hati Jaanu, gadis yang sepatutnya dijodohkan dengannya tetapi menolak tanpa sebab jelas. Apabila rahsia penolakan itu terbongkar, kisah bertukar daripada romantik komedi kepada aksi suspens

Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.title: Rock Bro!
programme.desc: Kisah kumpulan rock Rimba Bara meneruskan perjuangan mereka dalam industri muzik, namun konflik muncul apabila Jijoe jatuh cinta kepada legenda rock Ella dan menyebabkan band itu retak serta menimbulkan cabaran baru dalam kerjaya dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Nun Mati Bertemu Alif
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Alif dan Tanwin, dua sahabat yang terlibat dengan sindiket mencuri kasut tetapi nekad untuk berubah ketika Ramadan dan memulakan hidup baru — namun perjalanan mereka berubah selepas terlibat kemalangan.

programme.title: Next Stop, Somewhere
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Huang, seorang pelakon dari Hong Kong yang berpindah ke Taipei untuk mencari kebebasan tetapi terperangkap dalam kuarantin ketika pandemik. Pada masa yang sama, Kim, seorang wanita Vietnam yang berkahwin demi kestabilan kewangan, terjerat dalam hubungan cinta terlarang. Kedua-duanya berdepan konflik dan pengorbanan dalam usaha mencari kebebasan serta kebahagiaan hidup.

programme.title: Mukhsin
programme.desc: Filem ini menceritakan kisah cinta pertama seorang budak lelaki bernama Mukhsin dengan seorang gadis bernama Orked. Berlatar di kampung, mereka mengalami pengalaman manis dan penuh emosi dalam kehidupan seharian, persahabatan, serta hubungan keluarga. Filem ini mengangkat tema kepolosan, kasih sayang dan nostalgia zaman kanak-kanak.

Selepas itu, Ica menerima pelbagai ancaman hingga klinik hampir ditutup. Ica mengesyaki Maya, tetapi Maya menafikan. Siapakah sebenarnya dalang di sebalik gangguan itu?

programme.desc: Geo-ul moves into the mysterious apartment plagued by unexplained floor noise. Determined to solve the mystery, she faces unexpected challenges while uncovering the apartment's secrets.

programme.desc: A man bears the responsibility to take care of a deaf-blind girl unexpectedly, which turns out to be life-changing to both of them.
